name: maven
versions: Maven 3.8–3.9 with the project's existing JDK
notes: MAVEN_REPO is a shell placeholder: pass -Dmaven.repo.local on every Maven invocation. Preserve .mvn/maven.config and project wrapper choice. If generated settings are needed, write @config/maven/settings.xml with sandboxed file tools and use --settings "$MAVEN_CONFIG_DIR/settings.xml" on every invocation. Do not replace project settings or read ~/.m2/settings.xml without review; it may contain credentials. The local repository is isolated, not shared between checkouts.
